faq.q: What is the cost difference between Mangusta 80 and Sunseeker Predator 74 charters in Marbella?
faq.a: The Mangusta 80 starts at €4,719 for a 4-hour charter, including a jet ski. The Sunseeker Predator 74 is not in our fleet, but based on market rates in Puerto Banús, expect to pay €5,500–€6,000 for a similar 4-hour rental, often without extras like jet skis. The Mangusta 80 typically saves you 15–25% per hour.

faq.q: Which yacht is bigger: Mangusta 80 or Sunseeker Predator 74?
faq.a: The Mangusta 80 measures 24 metres (80 feet) with a beam of 5.5 metres. The Sunseeker Predator 74 is 22.5 metres (74 feet) with a beam of 5.2 metres. So the Mangusta 80 offers more deck space and interior volume, making it more spacious for groups.

faq.q: What is included in the Mangusta 80 charter price?
faq.a: Our Mangusta 80 charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). Plus, a jet ski is included free for the charter duration. No hidden costs.

faq.q: Does the Sunseeker Predator 74 come with a jet ski included?
faq.a: Typically, no. Most Sunseeker Predator 74 charters in Marbella charge extra for jet skis, often €200–€400 per hour. With our Mangusta 80, a jet ski is included in the base price, saving you significant additional costs.

faq.q: How many people can the Mangusta 80 and Sunseeker Predator 74 accommodate?
faq.a: Both yachts are certified for a maximum of 12 passengers. However, the Mangusta 80's larger beam provides more comfortable seating and sunbathing areas for a full group. The Predator 74 can feel slightly more cramped with 12 aboard.

faq.q: Which yacht is faster: Mangusta 80 or Sunseeker Predator 74?
faq.a: The Sunseeker Predator 74 has a slight edge in top speed, reaching around 32 knots, while the Mangusta 80 cruises at 24 knots and tops out at 28 knots. For most Marbella charters, the difference is negligible as you'll likely cruise at 20–22 knots.

faq.q: Where do these yachts depart from in Marbella?
faq.a: Both the Mangusta 80 and Sunseeker Predator 74 typically depart from Puerto Banús, the main superyacht marina in Marbella. From there, you can head to Cabopino, Cala del Faro, or Estepona. Our Mangusta 80 is based at Puerto Banús and ready for immediate charter.

faq.q: Is the Sunseeker Predator 74 available for charter through your fleet?
faq.a: No, the Sunseeker Predator 74 is not part of our fleet. We offer the Mangusta 80 (and its grey variant) as our premium 24m option. For comparable luxury at a better value, we recommend the Mangusta 80 or our Azimut 58 Flybridge.

data.body_html:
When comparing the Mangusta 80 vs Sunseeker Predator 74 cost comparison for Marbella charters, the Mangusta 80 wins on value. Our Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) starts at €4,719 for a 4-hour charter from Puerto Banús, with a jet ski included free. The Sunseeker Predator 74 (22.5m) is not in our fleet, but market rates in Marbella typically run 15–25% higher per hour, often without extras. Below, we break down the specs, inclusions, and real costs so you can decide which yacht suits your budget and group.

Size and Space Comparison

The Mangusta 80 measures 24 metres (80 feet) with a beam of 5.5 metres, offering generous deck and interior space. The Sunseeker Predator 74 is 22.5 metres (74 feet) with a 5.2-metre beam. That extra 1.5 metres in length and 0.3 metres in beam means the Mangusta 80 has more room for sunbathing, dining, and socialising. For groups of up to 12, the Mangusta 80 feels less cramped, especially on the flybridge.

Performance and Speed

The Predator 74 is slightly faster, topping out at around 32 knots compared to the Mangusta 80's 28 knots. However, most Marbella charters cruise at 20–22 knots along the coast from Puerto Banús to Cabopino or Estepona. The Mangusta 80's cruising speed of 24 knots is more than adequate for a relaxed day at sea. Fuel consumption is similar, but the Mangusta 80's larger fuel tanks offer longer range.

Inclusions and Hidden Costs

Our Mangusta 80 charter includes:

  • Licensed skipper and fuel
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%)
  • Jet ski included free

For a Sunseeker Predator 74, expect to pay extra for jet skis (€200–€400/hour), premium catering, and sometimes fuel surcharges. The Mangusta 80's all-inclusive pricing means no surprises.

Here's a direct cost comparison for a 4-hour charter in Marbella:

Availability and Booking

The Mangusta 80 is available for charter from Puerto Banús year-round. The Sunseeker Predator 74 is harder to find in Marbella; many are privately owned or chartered through third parties with limited availability. Our Mangusta 80 (white and grey variants) can be booked directly via WhatsApp. For a similar experience, consider our Azimut 58 Flybridge or Mangusta 80 variants.

Which Yacht Should You Choose?

If you want the best value for a group of up to 12, the Mangusta 80 is the clear winner. You get more space, a jet ski included, and transparent pricing. The Predator 74 offers slightly higher top speed and brand prestige, but at a significant premium. For most Marbella charters, the Mangusta 80 delivers everything you need for a memorable day on the water.
